text:
liam_csm: Heads up — AcmePay renewal in 6 weeks, usage down 42% month-over-month, onboarding stuck at 60% of seats. Risk: churn if we don't show quick ROI.

maria_cs: Ugh. Which modules are blocked? technical or enablement?

liam_csm: Mostly integrations and a couple of failed sample pipelines. They raised tickets but low engagement from their SRE.

jason_se: I can jump on an exec call to reset expectations. Suggest we offer a short-term uplift: 2-week focused enablement + temporary credits to cover extra calls while we fix integrations.

sophia_csm: Agreed. Draft playbook idea:
- Day 0: Exec alignment call (Jason)
- Day 1-3: Priority triage with eng (Liam + onboarding-bot logs)
- Day 4-10: Two enablement workshops (feature mapping + quick wins)
- Day 11-14: Follow-up success review + decision on downgrade vs renew
Include feedback capture after each session.

liam_csm: Nice. Can we offer a downgrade path if they insist? e.g., move from Pro -> Standard but keep their rate limits for 30d while they migrate features. That gives them breathing room.

maria_cs: Yes — propose a temporary "stability" bundle: keep current token pricing but reduce concurrency and remove non-core add-ons. Tell legal to prep an MOU for 30-day limited downgrade.

jason_se: I'll prep the exec email. Template:
```
Hi <Name>,
We see onboarding slowdown and want to partner on a 14-day recovery plan: exec alignment, hands-on triage, and two workshops. We'll also extend a 30-day stability bundle to avoid service disruption while we fix integrations.
Are you available for a 30-min call on <date>?
Thanks, Jason
```

sophia_csm: I'll schedule workshops and create the post-session NPS + 3-question feedback form: 1) Was the session helpful? 2) Any blockers remaining? 3) Confidence to proceed to production (1-5).

onboarding-bot: Note: AcmePay has 4 open onboarding tickets older than 7 days: #882, #889, #901. Assigned to eng-runtime.

liam_csm: Can eng-runtime prioritize two tickets (integration + pipeline failure)? Those are showstoppers. @ops_bot can you set priority to P1 for 48h?

ops_bot: Done — updated tickets #882 and #889 to P1 and added the on-call rotation. ETA initial triage in 4 hours.

maria_cs: Great. Next steps: Jason exec reachout today, schedule triage tomorrow, workshops Fri+Mon. I'll draft MOU and Sophia will own feedback. Liam will monitor KPIs (seat activation, token throughput) daily.

jason_se: :thumbsup: I'll send the email now and post the invite in the thread when scheduled.

liam_csm: Thanks team. If we hit the plan, target is to recover usage to >85% of prior baseline and convert to renewal. If any blocker, escalate here immediately.
